Off Calendar Oct-22-2002 Continued To Oct-23-02 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 611
MINI MINUTES: Judge diane wick, dept. 611, clerk-beth wilber, reporter-brenda fields:

9:00AM, c/c called for jury trial, Jonathan Bornstein appears for plaintiff, George yuhas and katherine ikeda appear for defendants. Counsel meet in chambers with Judge Wick, off the record to discuss pre-trial matters. Mr. Bornstein lodges some motions in limine with Judge Wick, in chambers; Ms. Ikdea lodges a trial brief with Judge Wick, in chambers. (The clerk will list motions in limine when the judge turns them over for filing.)
10:50AM
Court takes a lunch recess until 3:00PM. The clerk orders a jury panel of 58, for 10:00AM, to be kept on hold until called for.

3:00PM
Court reconvenes, all present including Mr. Daniel Bornstein. Counsel had previously stipulated that the daily damages for 4737 Irving St., lower unit are $30.75 daily with a monthly rent of $922.73. Defense counsel did not submit any motions in limine so the Court begins to hear plaintiff's motions in limine. Also in one of the in limine motions the Court questions whether "in-laws" qualify as "relative" for occupying an owner's unit. Judge Wick, at this time, denies the motion. The court states it believes there is an issue of fact having to do with the "upper unit".

Bornstein, Esq. appeared for the plaintiff and special appearance by Katherine K. Ikeda, Esq. appeared for the defendant. The case did not settle. Trial date is confirmed.
